# GROWNIS

> Full-funnel marketing agency — Senior expertise, AI speed. Founded by Maria Bratchikova and Alyona Kozlova. 15+ years of experience, AI tooling, and a network of trusted partners. Based in Barcelona, working with projects worldwide.

GROWNIS owns a client's growth funnel under a single point of accountability, acting as a fractional Head of Growth. Senior experts set direction, AI agents handle the volume, and experts validate the result — the Senior × AI model. No juniors on client projects. The agency covers the full funnel: from research and positioning to acquisition, content, data, and retention, plus marketplaces.

## FAQ
- What is GROWNIS? A full-funnel marketing agency acting as a fractional Head of Growth under a single point of accountability.
- What is the Senior × AI model? Senior experts set direction, AI agents handle volume and iterations, and experts validate the result — senior-level quality at AI speed, with no juniors on client projects.
- How does GROWNIS work with agencies? As a white-label or co-branded data & growth partner — the agency stays the face to the client while GROWNIS provides research, analytics, acquisition and retention behind the scenes.
- Where is GROWNIS based? Barcelona, Spain — working with projects worldwide.
- What languages does GROWNIS work in? English and Russian.

## Tech events — FAQ
- What is tech event marketing? Attracting, converting and retaining the right specialised audience — software engineers, AI researchers, developers, founders and technical decision-makers — for conferences, hackathons, competitions, demo days and summits, through the channels they actually use.
- What does GROWNIS do for tech events? Full-funnel marketing: positioning, participant acquisition, lifecycle communications (registration → attendance → community) and performance measurement.
- What types of events? Conferences, hackathons, AI competitions, developer events, startup demo days, innovation challenges and technology summits — strongest in AI, developer, enterprise-tech and deep-tech.
- How do you reach a niche technical audience? Go where they already are — developer communities, Discord/Telegram, GitHub, Hugging Face, Kaggle, LinkedIn, universities, partners and specialised media — on top of an analytics-driven registration funnel from first touch to registration.
- How do you increase attendance (show rate)? Pre-event lifecycle communication (welcome sequences, reminders, countdowns, milestone announcements) plus post-event flows that turn a one-off event into a returning community.
- How do you measure success? By business outcomes, not registrations alone: qualified registrations, attendance rate, submission rate, cost per registration/attendee, email engagement, community growth and post-event retention.
- Can you launch and promote an event in a few weeks? Yes. The Agentic RAG Challenge (a global legal-AI competition during Dubai AI Week) ran on a two-week promotion window: 356 teams vs a target of 100 (3.5×), 137 submissions and ~72% email open rates.
- How is it different from traditional event marketing? It reaches niche technical audiences that broad advertising misses — via community marketing, technical content, partnerships, developer platforms and PR — optimising for qualified, engaged participants rather than raw registration numbers.
